Data for:

Kielstra, B. W., Arnott, S. E. and Gunn, J. M. (2017), Subcatchment deltas and upland features influence multiscale aquatic ecosystem recovery in damaged landscapes. Ecol Appl, 27: 2249–2261. doi:10.1002/eap.1609

Data are separated by major components of the paper: 1) 'Regional Scale, 40-lake synoptic survey', 2) 'Subcatchment scale, six-lake abundance survey', 3) 'Subcatchment scale, single-lake abundance survey'.
